media_urls.note: Use the exact local assets specified in the problem statement. Do not use placeholder external URLs.

interactions.hover: Subtle border darkens, 0.3s ease. Minimal lift (-translate-y-1) on cards. Avoid bouncy physics.
interactions.scroll: Smooth layout flow. Ensure sufficient padding between sections to let the typography breathe.

testing.guidance: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute based on their role.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read and apply the exact JSON schema provided here.
2. Setup 'Cormorant Garamond' (heading) and 'Manrope' (body) via next/font or Google Fonts in your index.css.
3. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layout, keeping it asymmetric and editorial.
4. For forms (Contact inquiry) use Shadcn UI with customized spacing, sharp borders (rounded-sm), and the color palette defined above.
5. Ensure the Hero section text has sufficient contrast. Use the provided gradient overlay classes `bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80...` over the hero image.

6. Build the specifications table in the Product Detail page purely with horizontal borders. Avoid Shadcn Table if it introduces too much generic styling; use simple HTML `table`, `tr`, `td` with Tailwind classes defined above.
7. Render the global WhatsApp FAB component outside your page routes so it persists across every view.
8. Since no external APIs/databases are allowed, mock the 37 products into a local Javascript array/constants file and map over them for the products listing.
